templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum that layers AI-specific terms onto an existing product agreement, covering permitted use of AI services, ownership and handling of Input and Output, model training restrictions, and AI-related warranties and disclaimers.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA) governing a provider's use and disclosure of Protected Health Information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity, including safeguards, subcontractor flow-down, breach notification, and termination duties.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard SaaS agreement for selling access to a hosted cloud service, covering access and use rights, customer data, fees and payment, warranties, indemnification, limitation of liability, and term and termination.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: GDPR/CCPA-oriented Data Processing Agreement (DPA) setting out the controller, processor, and subprocessor relationships, processing instructions, security measures, international transfer mechanisms, and audit and deletion obligations.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for early-access design partnerships, giving a partner pre-release product access in exchange for feedback and program participation, and addressing feedback ownership, confidentiality, and publicity rights.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement — Cover Page
templates.description: Fill-in cover page for the Mutual NDA that captures the deal-specific key terms — the parties, purpose, confidentiality period, and any modifications — and incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms by reference.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement — Standard Terms
templates.description: Standard Terms for a two-way NDA allowing each party to disclose confidential information for an agreed purpose, covering permitted use and disclosure, exclusions, compelled disclosure, return or destruction of information, and remedies.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Commercial partnership agreement in which each party performs defined obligations set out in a cover page, addressing payment and taxes, feedback, intellectual property, confidentiality, and mutual liability terms.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Short-term paid or unpaid pilot agreement granting a customer access to a product for defined evaluation purposes during a pilot period, with conversion, feedback, confidentiality, and end-of-pilot terms.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Master services agreement for professional and consulting work delivered under statements of work (SOWs), covering service performance, deliverables and IP ownership, personnel, fees and expenses, and customer policies.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Service Level Agreement (SLA) defining target uptime for a cloud service, how uptime is calculated, excluded downtime, support response commitments, and service credits as the remedy for missed targets.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: License agreement for on-premise or self-hosted software, granting a limited non-exclusive license for a subscription period and covering usage restrictions, delivery, support, audit rights, and warranties.
